findings.text: the plan-ownership pass reads docs/plans HTML only and never a plan's live crew runs, which the steering brief requires; a queued node's sole upright directory scripts/prototypes/h200_levers is therefore delete with an empty reason while r-20261115T225214446552-smfp-lever-closing-h200 (sub-millisecond-forward-path, phase awaiting-upstream) declares it a write path, so section 3 can delete a pending node's drivers.

the clause that lets a plan naming one driver own that driver's directory fires only when the named token is itself a population file, so a plan naming a shell launcher confers nothing: docs/plans/kernel-compile-barrier.html names scripts/iron_operator_bound/west.sh, a live S31 node holds scripts/iron_operator_bound, and eight of its .py files are still delete with an empty reason.

the population assertion compares the census's own counts with the census's own population() over the same tracked() call, so a regression that drops a subtree while still holding the files the other tests anchor stays green; the independent git ls-files count that would redden lives only in the run directory's uncommitted verify_census.py.

the plan-sprint identifiers S28-S32 are written as a source constant and repeated in the module docstring at line 12, which the naming rules forbid in source and docstrings; the sprint window belongs in the emitted record or a resolved configuration, not in a module-level tuple.

item_verdicts.diff: Read f26e4620e17fd7ec8a9b63b8751772e2ade4de4a..aa3e594fb4a363c1db9746b0b1158ec582026e5b commit by commit (ten commits): four files, +2533 lines, all adds; the last commit is the record regeneration and the two before it change ownership scope and its tests.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when's four clauses are each asserted: coverage and reconciliation by verify_census.py, citation resolution by git cat-file -e inside benchmarks/scripts_census.py:404, merge folding by tests/test_scripts_census.py:47, and the forced-delete refusal by the three negative-control logs.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is one verdict per Python file under benchmarks/ and scripts/ stored in one record; benchmarks/scripts_census.py:606 emits exactly that and the committed record carries 1574 rows with keep=821 delete=750 merge=3.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read the reviewed run's manifest at runs/r-20261122T202601421489-bench-scripts-census/manifest.md: status complete, after_suite 9e33bd731 exit 0 completed true failure_count 0, three negative-control logs plus a specificity control, and reproduce/verify probe logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the declared pair docs/evidence/fragments/code-reuse-and-hot-path/bench-scripts-census.html and the figures directory; the diff also lands benchmarks/scripts_census.py, tests/test_scripts_census.py and the .json twin, none of which the declaration names.

justifications.durability: tests/test_scripts_census.py:108 asserts the forced delete of a live-test driver raises Refused naming it, which reddens if the guard at benchmarks/scripts_census.py:600 is removed, but the population reconciliation at tests/test_scripts_census.py:34 compares the census against its own enumeration.
justifications.evidence: logs/pytest-after-all_debug.log records 12 passed at revision 9e33bd7310bf282fa0096d2b1e344631b27536e0 with a bare EXIT=0, and verify_census.py re-enumerates the population with its own git ls-files and re-resolves every delete citation, VERIFY-OK.
justifications.fit: The module is ruff-clean and follows the surrounding driver idiom, but benchmarks/scripts_census.py:64 carries the plan-sprint identifiers S28-S32 as a source constant and the docstring at line 12 repeats them.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The record at docs/evidence/fragments/code-reuse-and-hot-path/bench-scripts-census.html gives one verdict to each of 1574 tracked files, but the keep rule at benchmarks/scripts_census.py:519 reads plan HTML only and never the live crew runs the steering brief requires.
justifications.reuse: Nova owns no tracked-file enumeration or verdict-census helper; worktree_path_candidates at nova/database/filepath.py:254 is a git-grep content search, and the addition reuses compute_provenance and repository_relative from the same module.
justifications.scope_discipline: benchmarks/scripts_census.py and tests/test_scripts_census.py sit outside the declared path pair but are implied by the plan and by the steering brief's own instruction to extend benchmarks/recovery_ladder_census.py under tests/test_recovery_ladder_census.py.
